# GrapesJS

> GrapesJS is an open-source JavaScript framework for building visual editors. GrapesJS Studio SDK builds on that framework to provide an embeddable, white-label editor for websites, landing pages, emails, and documents, with AI-assisted content creation.

Use Studio SDK to embed a ready-made editor in your application. Use the open-source GrapesJS framework to build and customize your own editor. Grapes Studio is the standalone AI website and email builder for users creating content directly.

Studio SDK documentation is hosted at app.grapesjs.com/docs-sdk. Open-source framework documentation is hosted at grapesjs.com/docs. These products have different APIs and licensing; consult the documentation for the product you are using. Refer to the relevant pricing page for current plans and limits.

## Products

- [Studio SDK overview](https://grapesjs.com/): Embeddable visual editor with customizable UI, reusable components, project storage integrations, and content export.
- [Embeddable AI email builder](https://grapesjs.com/sdk/embed-ai-email-builder): Integrate visual email design, MJML, responsive HTML export, and AI assistance into your product.
- [AI for Studio SDK](https://grapesjs.com/sdk/ai): Add an AI assistant to an embedded editor, with configurable models, prompts, tools, and backends.
- [Studio SDK pricing](https://grapesjs.com/sdk/pricing): Plans, licensing, features, and usage limits for embedding Studio SDK.
- [Grapes Studio AI](https://grapesjs.com/ai): Standalone AI website and email creation with visual editing and HTML export.
- [Grapes Studio pricing](https://grapesjs.com/pricing): Plans for the standalone builder.

## Studio SDK documentation

- [Getting started](https://app.grapesjs.com/docs-sdk/overview/getting-started): Install and embed Studio SDK using React or JavaScript.
- [Web projects](https://app.grapesjs.com/docs-sdk/project-types/web): Build website and landing page editing experiences.
- [Email projects](https://app.grapesjs.com/docs-sdk/project-types/email): Configure email editing and export.
- [Document projects](https://app.grapesjs.com/docs-sdk/project-types/document): Build editors for printable documents and layouts.
- [Plugins](https://app.grapesjs.com/docs-sdk/plugins/overview): Extend the editor with Studio plugins and integrations.
- [AI integration](https://app.grapesjs.com/docs-sdk/plugins/ai/overview): Configure AI capabilities for Studio SDK.
- [Agent Skills](https://github.com/GrapesJS/skills-studio-sdk): Documentation and integration patterns for AI coding agents working with Studio SDK.

## Open-source GrapesJS framework

- [Introduction and quick start](https://grapesjs.com/docs/): Framework concepts, installation, and a minimal editor setup.
- [Getting started tutorial](https://grapesjs.com/docs/getting-started.html): Build and customize an editor step by step.
- [Components](https://grapesjs.com/docs/modules/Components.html): Define component types, models, views, and editable content.
- [Editor API](https://grapesjs.com/docs/api/editor.html): Core editor methods, configuration, and events.
- [Source code](https://github.com/GrapesJS/grapesjs): Framework source, license, releases, and issue tracking.
